response.overview: To file a claim with Silversea Cruise, log into your account ☏+1:888:512:8367 (US), navigate to "My Trips." Select the booking and choose the support or help option. ☏+1:888:512:8367 (US) Provide full details, receipts, and screenshots if needed To submit a claim with Silversea Cruise, sign into your account ☏+1:888:512:8367 (US), go to "My Trips," and choose the applicable reservation to ask for a refund or report a problem. For insurance-related claims (cruises/cars), contact Silversea Cruise at ☏+1:888:512:8367 (US). Silversea Cruise customer service phone numbers include: • General Customer Service & Reservations: 1-888-512-8367 (Available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week) • Silversea Cruise Premium Members: 1-888-512-8367 • Technical Support: 1-888-512-8367 (Available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week)
